modules.title: Wallet Authentication
modules.blurb: Sign in with a crypto wallet; optional server session.
longDescription: Provides secure sign-in using a user’s wallet (SIWE-style), with an option to maintain a short-lived server session for convenience. It establishes a canonical identity that other modules reference for permissions and personalization.

Use this when users interact on-chain or when you need cryptographic proof of ownership. Typically connects to RBAC for roles, to KYC for compliance gating, and to device/session management for better security posture.

allowedWalletsPattern.description: Optional regex to restrict wallet addresses.

modules.title: Session Keys
modules.blurb: Scoped, time-limited keys for safer frequent actions.
longDescription: Creates short-lived, limited-scope session keys so users can perform frequent actions without re-signing every time. Reduces friction while preserving intent and auditability.

Combine with Wallet Authentication for identity binding, and consider Account Abstraction if you plan to sponsor gas. Define scopes carefully (e.g., trading vs. profile updates) and assign conservative TTLs.

modules.title: Social Login
modules.blurb: Web2 sign-in with optional custodial wallet.
longDescription: Adds OAuth-based sign-in (Google, Apple, GitHub, etc.) and can optionally pair users with a custodial wallet for instant onboarding. Useful when your audience is new to crypto.
Often used alongside Wallet Authentication to support both crypto-native and Web2 users. If using a custodial wallet, define clear limits and upgrade paths to self-custody.

modules.title: User Profiles
modules.blurb: Public profiles with avatars and basic metadata.
longDescription: Stores public-facing profile information such as display name, avatar, and bio. Useful for any consumer-facing app where identity matters beyond an address.
Typically connects to media storage for avatars and to social features like feeds or chat. Consider reserved handles and moderation policies early.

modules.title: Role-Based Access Control
modules.blurb: Roles and permissions for routes, actions, and data.
longDescription: Provides a flexible role and permission system for protecting APIs, UI actions, and on-chain operations. Map users to roles and check permissions consistently across the stack.
Pair with Wallet Authentication to identify users, and with Organization Accounts when roles span teams. Keep policies granular but readable; document admin-only actions.

reasonByDepId.wallet-auth: RBAC needs a verified identity to attach roles and evaluate permissions.

modules.title: Organization Accounts
modules.blurb: Team workspaces, members, and shared resources.
longDescription: Enables multi-user organizations with shared resources, roles, and billing. Useful for B2B products or creator teams managing assets together.
Integrates with RBAC for fine-grained permissions and with Invoices/Billing for paid plans. Decide early how ownership transfers and member offboarding should work.

reasonByDepId.wallet-auth: Organizations require authenticated identities to manage membership and ownership.

modules.title: Device & Session Trust
modules.blurb: Bind sessions to trusted devices; manage active sessions.
longDescription: Introduces device binding and session management to reduce token theft risk and improve account security. Track and revoke active sessions across devices.
Use with Wallet Authentication so sessions map to real identities. Combine with RBAC for high-risk action prompts and with Notifications for unusual activity alerts.

reasonByDepId.wallet-auth: Device trust policies must be enforced against authenticated user identities.

modules.title: KYC / Identity Verification
modules.blurb: Verify user identity and gate restricted features.
longDescription: Adds know-your-customer (KYC) checks for users who must pass identity verification before accessing restricted features. Supports multiple providers and levels.
Use when your product has regulatory requirements or higher fraud risk. Gate sensitive actions (e.g., withdrawals) and re-check periodically to meet policy.

reasonByDepId.wallet-auth: Identity verification results must be bound to an authenticated user/wallet.

modules.title: Gasless Relayer
modules.blurb: Sponsor transaction gas for better onboarding.
longDescription: Lets the app sponsor gas for selected actions so new users can transact without first buying crypto. Improves conversion in early funnels and mobile flows.
Use allowlists and limits to control cost. Pair with Wallet Authentication to identify who receives sponsorship. Consider risk rules for high value operations and add rate limits.

modules.title: Fiat On-Ramp
modules.blurb: Convert local currency to crypto inside the app.
longDescription: Allows users to buy crypto using cards or local payment rails and credits their wallet after settlement. Reduces drop off for users who do not hold tokens yet.
Select regional providers that match your compliance needs. Connect to Treasury for accounting and to Notifications or Email for receipts and status updates.

modules.title: Fiat Off-Ramp
modules.blurb: Let users cash out to bank accounts or wallets.
longDescription: Enables settlement back into fiat so users can withdraw earnings or balances. Useful for marketplaces, creator payouts, and enterprise invoicing.
Implement KYC and AML screening for withdrawals. Connect to Treasury for ledgers and to Emails for statements. Consider hold periods to mitigate chargeback risk.

reasonByDepId.kyc: Regulated off-ramps require verified user identity before payouts.

modules.title: Invoices and Billing
modules.blurb: Invoices, receipts, and tax friendly records.
longDescription: Adds invoicing, receipts, and customer billing profiles for B2B or prosumer products. Generates compliant documents for accounting and tax purposes.
Integrates with fiat providers and Treasury. Consider per country tax rules and digital signatures. Pair with Emails for automatic delivery.

modules.title: Discounts and Coupons
modules.blurb: Promo codes, limited time offers, and bundles.
longDescription: Lets you create coupon codes, limited time discounts, and product bundles. Works with on-chain and off-chain payments.
Scope promotions to user segments and plans. Prevent abuse with rate limits and unique code generation. Connect to Analytics to measure uplift.

modules.title: UPI Payments
modules.blurb: Unified Payments Interface support for India.
longDescription: Adds UPI as a first class payment option for purchases and credits. Helps local users pay instantly with familiar flows.
Usually integrated through a provider adapter such as Razorpay. Consider UPI intent on mobile and reconcile postings in Treasury.

modules.title: ERC-20 Token
modules.blurb: Fungible token for payments, rewards, and fees.
longDescription: Implements a standard fungible token contract suitable for payments, rewards, and protocol fees. Provides mint, burn, and transfer hooks as needed.
Plan decimals and supply based on your economy. Connect to Treasury for accounting and to Subscriptions, Staking, or AMM modules when you use the token for utility.

modules.title: ERC-721 NFT
modules.blurb: Non fungible tokens for unique assets.
longDescription: Implements a standard NFT collection with mint, transfer, and metadata support. Suitable for art, gaming items, access tokens, and collectibles.
Pair with NFT Minting for sale flows and with Royalties for secondary market revenue. Plan metadata storage through IPFS or a media pipeline.

modules.title: ERC-1155 Multi-Token
modules.blurb: Batch friendly multi token standard.
longDescription: Implements a multi token contract that handles both fungible and non fungible types in one collection. Efficient for games and complex drops.
Plan token id ranges and supply per id. Pair with Marketplace if you plan to trade items and with Metadata Pipeline for dynamic content.

modules.title: ERC-4626 Vault
modules.blurb: Tokenized vault shares for strategies.
longDescription: Implements a vault that issues share tokens against an underlying ERC-20 asset. Useful for automated strategies and pooled deposits.
Choose an underlying with sufficient liquidity and plan withdrawal mechanics. Consider fees and performance reporting.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Vault shares represent deposits of a specific ERC-20 asset.

modules.title: Soulbound Token
modules.blurb: Non transferable tokens linked to identities.
longDescription: Creates non transferable tokens that represent credentials or status. Useful for certifications, compliance badges, and membership proofs.
Decide revocation rules and who can issue or burn. Pair with KYC or external verifiers when the credential has legal weight.

modules.title: Badges and Achievements
modules.blurb: Gamified badges for milestones and contributions.
longDescription: Defines badge models and minting rules based on user activity. Encourages engagement in communities and games.
Connect to Analytics or Event Bus to trigger awards. Decide if badges are on-chain NFTs or off-chain profile items.

modules.title: Merkle Airdrops
modules.blurb: Efficient token or NFT airdrops using proofs.
longDescription: Supports large airdrops by publishing a Merkle root and letting recipients claim with proofs. Scales better than individual transfers.
Build claim lists carefully and monitor gas. Pair with Emails or Notifications to inform eligible users and provide claim links.

modules.title: Token Vesting
modules.blurb: Linear and cliff schedules for token grants.
longDescription: Provides time based token release for teams, investors, and community programs. Supports cliffs, linear unlocks, and revocation.
Plan schedules in relation to governance and liquidity events. Pair with Treasury for accounting and with Analytics for progress reports.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Vesting releases an ERC-20 token over time to recipients.

modules.title: Buyback and Burn
modules.blurb: Automated buybacks and token burns.
longDescription: Implements periodic buybacks and token burns based on treasury policies. Can improve long term supply dynamics when used responsibly.
Define triggers and limits clearly. Connect to Treasury for funding and to Analytics for transparent reporting.

reasonByDepId.treasury: Buybacks are funded from designated treasury accounts.
reasonByDepId.erc20: The burn and accounting logic operates on an ERC-20 token.

modules.title: Token Bridge
modules.blurb: Abstraction for bridging tokens across chains.
longDescription: Adds a bridge interface that can connect to different providers to move tokens across networks. Keeps the app level integration stable as providers change.
Select providers that match your security and cost profile. Consider fast finality and failure modes. Expose status in UI so users trust the flow.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Bridging moves balances of a specific ERC-20 token between chains.

modules.title: NFT Minting
modules.blurb: Phased drops, allowlists, limits, and royalties.
longDescription: Provides a production-grade minting workflow for NFT collections, including allowlists, phased releases, per-wallet limits, and automatic royalty metadata. It is designed to handle high-traffic drops with predictable performance.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Minting NFTs requires the ERC-721 contract to define ownership and metadata.

modules.title: NFT Metadata Pipeline
modules.blurb: Image processing, JSON metadata, and upload.
longDescription: Prepares images and metadata for NFT collections at scale. Generates JSON metadata, resizes assets, and uploads to the chosen storage. Helps ensure metadata consistency and predictable mint performance.
Use with NFT Minting for primary sales and with Dynamic NFT when traits update on chain. Configure storage to IPFS or a managed bucket and plan for backups and content hashing.

modules.title: NFT Reveal and Randomization
modules.blurb: Delayed reveal with provable randomness.
longDescription: Supports delayed reveal strategies where art or traits are hidden until a scheduled time. Assigns metadata using provable randomness to avoid manipulation.
Use with NFT Minting for hype cycles and with Oracles or a randomness beacon if you require verifiable draws. Communicate reveal schedules clearly in the UI and enforce them on chain.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Reveal mechanics map final metadata to specific ERC-721 token IDs.

modules.title: NFT Rarity Engine
modules.blurb: Trait frequencies and rarity scoring.
longDescription: Calculates rarity scores from trait frequencies across a collection. Exposes rankings for discovery and marketplace displays.
Run it after metadata is finalized or post-reveal. Cache results for performance and expose APIs for your UI and partners.

reasonByDepId.nft-metadata-pipeline: Rarity is computed from the finalized trait metadata generated by the pipeline.

modules.title: NFT Rentals and Delegation
modules.blurb: Time-limited access without transferring ownership.
longDescription: Allows owners to delegate usage rights for a limited time without transferring ownership. Useful for games, events, and short-term access products.
Define permitted actions during rental, such as play or display. Use Notifications to alert parties before expiry and ensure clear settlement rules.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Delegation rules are applied to unique token IDs defined by ERC-721.

modules.title: Dynamic NFT
modules.blurb: On-chain updates to traits or media.
longDescription: Enables NFTs whose metadata can update based on events or progression. Useful for games, achievements, and evolving collectibles.
Decide authority for updates and audit trails. Pair with Oracles for external signals and with Rarity Engine if traits influence rankings.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Dynamic updates target specific token IDs defined by ERC-721.

modules.title: Multi-chain NFT Sync
modules.blurb: Mirror and track NFTs across networks.
longDescription: Keeps NFT state consistent across supported chains. Mirrors ownership and metadata to extend reach without splitting communities.
Plan authority of truth and synchronize events with care. Consider bridge security and indexer consistency before enabling writes.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Cross-chain synchronization starts from a primary collection that follows ERC-721.

modules.title: Royalty Standard
modules.blurb: EIP-2981 royalties for creators.
longDescription: Implements royalty metadata so secondary marketplaces can route a portion of sales to creators. Helps align incentives and long term value.
Pair with NFT Minting to attach royalty data at source. Provide a payout address or a splitter for teams and collaborators.

reasonByDepId.erc721: Royalty information is carried with ERC-721 tokens to guide secondary sales.

modules.title: Automated Market Maker
modules.blurb: Simple swaps with constant product pools.
longDescription: Provides swap pools following a constant product formula with fees and liquidity provider shares. Suitable for basic token markets and utility swaps.
Price integrity depends on oracle design and liquidity depth. Connect to Oracles for sanity checks and to Analytics for pool health dashboards.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Swaps occur between ERC-20 tokens and require allowance mechanics.

modules.title: Lending and Borrowing
modules.blurb: Over-collateralized loans with interest.
longDescription: Enables users to deposit collateral and borrow assets against it with interest. Supports liquidation thresholds and reserve factors.
Choose assets with reliable price feeds and sufficient liquidity. Connect to Oracles for prices and to Analytics for risk monitoring.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Lending and borrowing are denominated in ERC-20 assets.
reasonByDepId.oracles: Loan-to-value and liquidations require accurate price information.

modules.title: Stablecoin Treasury
modules.blurb: Manage stable reserves and policy actions.
longDescription: Adds policy controls for stablecoin reserves, rebalancing, and peg maintenance. Useful for products that maintain a treasury of stable assets.
Define guardrails for rebalances and reporting intervals. Connect to Analytics for transparency and to Governance if policies require votes.

reasonByDepId.treasury: Reserves and policy actions operate on treasury accounts and ledgers.

modules.title: Vault Strategies
modules.blurb: Plug-in strategies for ERC-4626 vaults.
longDescription: Defines strategy interfaces and plug-ins that ERC-4626 vaults can run to earn yield. Allows safe deployment and upgrades of strategies.
Control permissions around who can install strategies. Expose performance reports to users and consider guard rails for drawdowns.

reasonByDepId.erc4626: Strategies operate on deposits held within a specific ERC-4626 vault.

modules.title: Liquid Staking
modules.blurb: Stake assets and receive transferable receipt tokens.
longDescription: Allows users to stake assets and receive transferable receipt tokens that represent the staked position. Improves liquidity while keeping staking rewards.
Plan redemption and slashing rules. Connect to Oracles for pricing and to Analytics for APR and utilization metrics.

reasonByDepId.erc20: Staking and receipt tokens are ERC-20 based assets.
reasonByDepId.oracles: Accurate pricing helps users understand value and risk.

modules.title: Perpetuals (Lite)
modules.blurb: Basic perpetual futures with capped risk.
longDescription: Introduces a simplified perpetuals engine with caps and conservative parameters. Suitable for education or controlled environments.
Requires robust oracle feeds and risk checks. Monitor funding rates and liquidations in Analytics and communicate risks clearly to users.

reasonByDepId.oracles: Perpetual pricing and liquidations depend on timely and accurate price feeds.
reasonByDepId.treasury: Margin, collateral, and payouts are accounted in treasury ledgers.

modules.title: Price and Portfolio
modules.blurb: Price feeds, holdings, and charts for users.
longDescription: Aggregates prices and user holdings to render balances and charts in the app. Helps users understand exposure and performance at a glance.
Feeds typically come from Oracles. Store time series sparsely to control costs and preload key views in Analytics for speed.

reasonByDepId.oracles: Reliable price feeds are required to value positions and render charts.

modules.title: On-chain Voting
modules.blurb: Token or membership voting with quorum and delays.
longDescription: Adds governance voting with configurable quorum, threshold, and delay parameters. Works for token voting or membership voting depending on your community model.
Decide whether proposals execute automatically or require a timelock. Pair with Proposals for authoring and with Treasury if votes control budgets.

modules.title: Proposals
modules.blurb: Author, discuss, and queue actions for votes.
longDescription: Provides a proposal lifecycle with drafting, discussion, and queueing actions to be executed after approval. Useful for community decisions and budget allocations.
Integrate with Voting to advance proposals and with Treasury for spending actions. Expose clear statuses in the UI to build trust.

modules.title: Treasury
modules.blurb: Budgets, ledgers, and payouts for the protocol.
longDescription: Adds a ledger and policy layer for protocol finances. Tracks inflows and outflows, prepares reports, and enforces approvals for spending.
Connect to Voting and Proposals for budget control and to Billing or Off-Ramp for payments. Document who can initiate transfers and how audits are handled.

modules.title: Logic and Actions Editor
modules.blurb: Visual flows for triggers, actions, and checks.
longDescription: Lets you design business logic as visual flows that run on user actions or on-chain events. Supports branching, loops, and calls to other modules.
Draw edges to indicate data sources and side effects. Keep critical checks simple and test flows with sample payloads before enabling in production.

modules.title: On-chain Data Models
modules.blurb: Reusable storage patterns and mappers.
longDescription: Provides common on-chain data structures and mapping helpers for lists, sets, and relationships. Reduces boilerplate and improves safety.
Use with Logic Editor and Subgraph Indexer to keep views fresh. Plan gas-aware schemas and consider how data will be read in the UI.

modules.title: External Data Oracles
modules.blurb: Bring off-chain data into deterministic logic.
longDescription: Fetches and verifies external data for use in contracts and flows, such as prices and reference rates. Helps protocols react to real-world events.
Control update frequency and fallbacks. Pair with Chainlink or a trusted adapter and document how stale data affects actions.

modules.title: Event Bus
modules.blurb: Publish and subscribe to app events.
longDescription: Adds a lightweight pub-sub layer for decoupling features. Modules can publish events and subscribe to react to changes without tight coupling.
Use it for side effects like emails, analytics tracking, or cache invalidation. Keep event contracts stable to avoid ripple changes.

modules.title: Subgraph Indexer
modules.blurb: Index contract events into queryable views.
longDescription: Streams contract events into a query layer for fast reads. Useful for feeds, leaderboards, and dashboards without complex on-chain iteration.
Define entities that mirror your contracts and keep mappings simple. Coordinate schema updates with app deploys to avoid broken queries.

modules.title: Full-text Search
modules.blurb: Search indexes for content and profiles.
longDescription: Adds a search engine for names, posts, and catalog data with typo tolerance and ranking. Improves discovery and navigation.
Keep indexes lean by selecting important fields. Refresh on event bus messages and expose filters for precision.

modules.title: Cache
modules.blurb: Low latency reads and rate limiting helpers.
longDescription: Provides a cache and primitive counters for reducing load and enabling quotas. Useful for hot pages and limited endpoints.
Define eviction policy and TTLs. Make cache misses safe and idempotent and monitor hit rates in Analytics.

modules.title: Notifications
modules.blurb: In-app and push notifications for key events.
longDescription: Delivers real-time in-app alerts and optional push messages so users do not miss important events. Helps with engagement and trust.
Wire to Event Bus to trigger messages. Pair with Emails for transactional follow up and allow users to control preference settings.

modules.title: Transactional Emails
modules.blurb: Receipts, alerts, and passwordless codes.
longDescription: Sends transactional messages such as receipts and security alerts. Supports templates and localization for consistent communication.
Connect through SendGrid or SES adapters. Publish events for delivery status and keep templates versioned with your code.

modules.title: Chat and Messaging
modules.blurb: Direct messages and channels with moderation.
longDescription: Adds private and group conversations with basic moderation tools. Useful for communities, support, and trading coordination.
Store messages securely and respect privacy laws. Consider spam controls and report workflows, and decide retention policies early.

modules.title: Social Feed
modules.blurb: Activity feeds and lightweight posts.
longDescription: Provides a timeline of events and short posts to drive discovery and community. Useful for NFT drops, markets, and creator apps.
Index on the Subgraph or Search module and implement moderation. Allow follows, mutes, and content filters for relevance.

modules.title: Feature Flags
modules.blurb: Roll out changes safely to segments.
longDescription: Controls feature availability by environment, user segment, or percentage. Reduces risk during launches and experiments.
Keep flag names stable and document default states. Audit changes and avoid mixing flags with long term product decisions.

modules.title: A/B Testing
modules.blurb: Run experiments and measure impact.
longDescription: Assigns users to variants and measures outcomes for features and flows. Helps teams make data-informed decisions.
Define clear success metrics in Analytics and keep experiments short. Avoid overlapping tests that interact unpredictably.

reasonByDepId.analytics: Experiments need reliable metrics to evaluate variant performance.

modules.title: Referrals
modules.blurb: Referral links and reward accounting.
longDescription: Generates referral links and credits rewards for successful conversions. Useful for growth loops and community sales.
Guard against self-referrals and fraud. Tie payouts to Treasury and communicate reward status clearly to users.

modules.title: AML Screening
modules.blurb: Screen users and addresses for sanctions risk.
longDescription: Checks users and wallet addresses against sanctions and risk lists. Reduces exposure to compliance incidents in fiat flows and withdrawals.
Run checks during onboarding and before sensitive actions. Keep an audit trail and error gracefully when providers are unavailable.

modules.title: Fraud Rules
modules.blurb: Heuristics and velocity checks for abuse.
longDescription: Applies rule-based checks to detect suspicious behavior, such as rapid signups, multiple wallets, or abuse patterns. Blocks or flags actions.
Tune thresholds over time and monitor false positives. Combine with Rate Limit and Device Trust for stronger protection.

modules.title: Rate Limit
modules.blurb: Per-user and per-route quotas and throttles.
longDescription: Adds global and per-user throttles to protect APIs and costly actions. Helps manage abuse and keep operating costs predictable.
Define separate limits for sign-in, minting, and withdrawals. Emit metrics so you can tune without guesswork.

modules.title: Audit Logs
modules.blurb: Tamper-evident logs for sensitive actions.
longDescription: Captures a signed record of sensitive actions and configuration changes. Improves accountability and incident response.
Store logs with retention policies and secure access. Pair with Audit Export for compliance and with Alerts for critical events.

modules.title: Terms and Consent
modules.blurb: Collect and track user consent versions.
longDescription: Displays legal terms and records explicit consent with versioning. Helps meet regulatory obligations and informs users.
Integrate with onboarding and gate sensitive actions if consent is missing. Keep past versions available for review.

modules.title: CMS Pages
modules.blurb: Editable marketing and help pages.
longDescription: Enables non-technical authors to edit public pages such as marketing and help content. Keeps product teams fast without code deploys.
Define roles that can publish. Use draft previews and track changes so updates are safe and auditable.

modules.title: Theme and Branding
modules.blurb: Logos, colors, and components theming.
longDescription: Centralizes brand settings such as colors, logos, and typography. Ensures a consistent look across generated UI components.
Expose presets for quick starts and allow per-page overrides when needed. Keep contrast and accessibility in mind.

modules.title: Internationalization
modules.blurb: Translate UI and content for multiple locales.
longDescription: Adds translation keys, locale routing, and formatting helpers so your app can serve multiple markets cleanly.
Choose default locale and fallback behavior. Keep keys stable to avoid translation churn and version templates with code.

longDescription: Provides uploads, transformations, and asset management for images and files. Supports IPFS or a managed bucket for storage.
